title: 잭 리처: 네버 고 백
ctx: Film 「Jack Reacher: Never Go Back」(2016, Paramount/Skydance, director Edward Zwick). Tom Cruise as Jack Reacher, a former Army military police major and drifter; Cobie Smulders as Major Susan Turner, his successor as commander of the 110th MP unit, arrested on a false espionage charge; Danika Yarosh as Samantha Dutton, a 15-year-old girl who may be Reacher's daughter; Patrick Heusinger as The Hunter, a ruthless private military assassin; Aldis Hodge as Captain Anthony Espin, an MP officer; Robert Knepper as General Harkness, head of the defense contractor Parasource; Holt McCallany as Colonel Morgan. Plot: Turner's two soldiers in Afghanistan were killed after discovering Parasource was smuggling weapons and opium; Reacher breaks her out and they flee with Samantha to New Orleans.
